about: ON-3, the Showcase (docs/phases/online-track.md; logic/showcase.js): the weekly themes, one a week from Monday 00:00 UTC in this order and round again, and the ribbons the theme's top entries earn (cosmetic: shown on the Billie and the Trainer card, never in battle). The owner's first three, 2026-10-27.

themes.name: Best abomination
themes.d: A Billie from a risky egg gone wrong, or one spliced past its Stability.

themes.name: Most Bureau
themes.d: A Billie wearing the Bureau's hardware: one with Augments.

themes.name: Best splice
themes.d: A Billie with another line's parts grafted on.
